metaDescription: Order custom plastic sunglasses for events or promotions. Perfect for outdoor giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom plastic sunglasses offer a lightweight and durable option for outdoor events, trade shows, and company picnics. Unlike metal frames, plastic styles like the Malibu or Gatsby Recycled Frame are comfortable for all-day wear and available in a variety of colors and finishes, from tortoise shell to wood grain. Add your logo with pad printing or an etched design for a polished look that stands out under the sun.
heroAltText: Bulk custom plastic sunglasses with logo imprint in assorted colors for promotional events
